note: One {template_id, template_sha256, frozen_page_sha256} per frozen template. template_sha256 is rq.templates.template_sha256(template). frozen_page_sha256 is the sha256 of the coordinator's RQ_TEMPLATES_V1_FREEZE_1 page for the Linux pins (the queue checks template_id and template_sha256 only); the HK pins get a FREEZE_2 page. Empty or unlisted = not admissible. The two HK templates are unpinned for now (plan-coord 11-23): their launch design is replaced in the follow-up PR and they are not admissible.
